scientific_queries.note: Replication of the program's central negative claim on a never-analysed design in the same archive.

subagent_note: None dispatched: the replication is a direct test and its direction is unambiguous (9/9 layouts).

design.note: The ordering here is across different compound pairs at one dose each, not across dose ratios within a grid: same family, different object from R5.

interpretation: the direction replicates (gap +0.14 vs +0.18 on validation plates) but the absolute cross-cell agreement is high (0.816), so the claim must read 'largely shared yet systematically below the reproducibility ceiling by 0.14-0.18', not 'ordering is inconsistent'

register_updates.C2: upgraded to replicated on two independent designs, with the sharpened wording
register_updates.unchanged: C3-C5 stay exploratory; they rest on the validation-plate dose-grid unit and are not transferred by this result
